raw_example.title: Brightening Lip Balm with SPF 50 - 1% Vitamin C + 0.1% Resorcinol
raw_example.body_html: Deconstruct Brightening Lip balm with SPF 50, PA +++ is formulated to protect your lips from sun damage without leaving any white cast. With consistent usage it helps in brightening the lips & provides intense moisturisation to dry & chapped lips for men & women. The 1% Vitamin C helps repair lip discolouration, and 0.1% Resorcinol fights against pigmentation caused by sun. The SPF 50, PA+++ broad spectrum lip balm protects lips against harmful UV rays with no white cast and brightens the lips.
